findings.title: Skipped near-misses aren't re-surfaced at the closing note (inconsistent with `migration.ts`). When `skipped.length > 0`, the warning is logged inline at Line 6
findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: At head, install.ts sets sweepIncomplete when skipped.length > 0 and logs a warning again right after 'Migration created', before the Next Steps note, so near-misses are re-surfaced.
